approval_required_for: Any downstream change to operator order, edge topology, transfer_order, AXI full-beat policy, FIFO implementation template, FIFO depth outside the accepted bounded set, memory base address assignment, numeric width policy, or introduction of unsupported flow-control primitives.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block evidence-gate promotion and route the specific failing edge, buffer, splitter, or join to bounded pipeline_repair; do not relax transfer counts, reorder streams, or claim hardware pass.
executable_actions.rationale: Convert the accepted static stream/liveness review into the expected handoff artifacts for the evidence gate, preserving exact edge mirrors, transfer counts, full-beat policy, branch/join contracts, and FIFO bindings.

executable_actions.on_failure: Return to bounded pipeline_repair for only the affected edge, FIFO depth, splitter, or join. Require explicit approval before changing architecture, memory layout, numeric policy, or supported template primitives.
executable_actions.rationale: Ensure the next stage binds the static plan to trusted templates without changing the ready/valid protocol, full-beat AXI assumptions, transfer order, FIFO depths, atomic split behavior, or all-valid join behavior.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep verification planning blocked until the missing order/count/deadlock obligations are restored; do not proceed to real simulation, Vivado, or board runtime without these requirements.
executable_actions.rationale: Record that later generated RTL must be checked with data-order traces, transfer-count checks, and deadlock watchdogs before any implementation or hardware pass can be claimed.

observations: No active contamination barriers, open retry requests, or open backtrack requests are present in the supplied SACG state summary; no SACG-memory blocker is carried into this stream/liveness review.

stream_edges and data_edges are mirrored in the visible artifact for all 13 edges, including block_input boundary edges, residual-skip edges, the MLP gate/up branch, join inputs, and block_output. The supplied stream_data_edge_mirror_check passed with edges=13 and edge_stream_contract_check passed with checked_edges=13.

All visible edges use transfer_order [token, tile, lane, word], flow_control ready_valid, and valid_byte_policy full_beats_only. This preserves a single pairing key across residual joins and the activation-multiply join.

Transfer counts are coherent with tensor shape and 512-bit AXI beats: seven 32-bit hidden-width edges use seq_len=16, width=896, transfer_count_bytes=57344, axi_beats=896, stream_beats_per_axi_beat=2; three 16-bit hidden-width edges use transfer_count_bytes=28672, axi_beats=448, stream_beats_per_axi_beat=4; three 16-bit intermediate-width edges use width=4864, transfer_count_bytes=155648, axi_beats=2432, stream_beats_per_axi_beat=4. All listed byte counts are multiples of the 64-byte AXI beat size.

Branch/join contracts are liveness-safe at the static contract level: residual_add_1 joins block_input residual_skip with self_attention main at matching 896 AXI beats; activation_mul joins gate and up branches at matching 2432 AXI beats; residual_add_2 joins residual_skip and down_proj main at matching 896 AXI beats. All joins use all required inputs valid before fire and pairing_key [token, tile, lane, word].

The explicit split contract at stage_03_rms_norm_2 uses ready_valid_broadcast_with_per_output_fifo, accepts a source beat only when both branch FIFOs can enqueue the same token/tile/lane/word, and allows independent branch dequeue under downstream ready. This bounds skew without relying on equal latency.

The buffer plan contains 13 buffers for 13 edges. Every buffer is kind bounded_ready_valid_fifo, implementation trusted_queue_template, resource_class on_chip_fifo, with allowed depths 32 or 64. No unbounded buffer or ping-pong memory is used as a stream FIFO in the supplied plan.

The supplied branch_join_contract_check, buffer_contract_check, and liveness_backpressure_check passed. The liveness evidence is static: the graph is acyclic and bounded FIFOs provide elasticity and backpressure; it is not a latency-equality, throughput, or hardware pass claim.

memory_runtime_contract_check passed with regions=6 and axi_bits=512. The stream audit only checks handoff readiness to the 64-byte AXI beat policy and does not assign or approve final DDR base addresses.
Symbolic_first_order latency values in the stage records are correctly labeled as planning estimates only and must not be consumed as timing, throughput, or hardware evidence.
proposed_actions: Hand off the accepted stream/liveness findings to pipeline_planning.evidence_gate_auditor with the checker-backed status and the explicit caveat that no real RTL/simulation/Vivado evidence is claimed at this stage.

Materialize edge_transfer_count_matrix.json and branch_join_buffer_liveness_findings.json from the accepted candidate artifact so downstream parameter binding can lock exact edge IDs, transfer_order, transfer_count_bytes, axi_beats, FIFO depths, and split/join rules.

During Stage 4 template binding, enforce trusted bounded ready/valid FIFO templates and the atomic broadcast/all-valid join semantics exactly; any deviation should be routed to bounded pipeline_repair rather than free-form RTL changes.
During later verification planning, require data-order traces, transfer-count checks, and deadlock watchdog evidence on generated RTL before any hardware or board-level pass is claimed.
output.summary: Static pipeline-planning stream/liveness review accepts the supplied contract for downstream evidence-gate consumption. The supplied checker evidence shows 13 stream_edges mirrored by 13 data_edges, coherent full-beat 512-bit AXI transfer counts, ready/valid split and all-input-valid join contracts with matched pairing keys, and one bounded trusted FIFO per edge. This is not hardware, timing, or throughput proof; later template binding and verification must preserve and test the contract.
